apply_masks_concat: apply masks to a tensor and concatenate the masked patch selections along dimension 0
apply_masks_no_concat: apply masks to a tensor and return a list of separately masked patch selections
apply_masks_gather_patches: gather specific patch indices from a batched tensor using mask index tensors
apply_masks_repeat_mask: unsqueeze and repeat a mask tensor to match the feature dimension for gathering
apply_masks_batched_tensor: apply multiple mask tensors to a single batched tensor and collect results
